item.title: Armed Attacker Targets Ohio Dem Candidate Amy Acton
item.description: An armed individual lunged at Amy Acton, the Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair on Sunday, injuring several.

item.title: Rep. Hern: Socialism Thrives Among Democrats
item.description: Rep. Kevin Hern told Newsmax on Saturday that the rise of democratic socialist candidates shows the ideology has moved from the fringes of the Democratic Party.
